references.text: Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, which is the source of the cities given to the Levites in Joshua 21:9
Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Simeon, which together with Judah gave cities to the Levites
Explains that the descendants of Kohath received cities from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin by lot
Lists the names of the cities given from Judah and Simeon, referred to in verse 9
God's command to Moses that the tribes should give cities to the Levites from their inheritance
Parallel text in Chronicles describing the same cities given to the descendants of Aaron from Judah and Simeon
